title: Missed Bin Collection Recovery Watch
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bincollection:event status=missed
| stats latest(_time) as last_missed, count as misses by collection_type
| eval days_since=round((now()-last_missed)/86400,0)
| sort - last_missed
description: Tracks which collection types you are most likely to miss and how recently it happened.
value: Missing the right bin on the wrong week creates outsized hassle, so it is worth making the weak point obvious.
implementation: Send collection reminders and outcomes to `index=personal`; summarize missed pickups by waste type.
visualization: Table of collection types with miss count and days since last miss.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which bins you keep missing and how recently it happened, so the same annoying mistake does not repeat.
